Advanced Vehicle Systems Limited.note: Advanced Vehicle Systems Limited was formed from parent company Multi Vehicle Technology LTD and remains an active, independent company.

Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited.note: Ashwoods Lightfoot Limited demerged in 2017, and its brand Lightfoot was later acquired by Volpi Capital in 2021.

Bluepoppy Solutions.note: The company operates as an independent fleet operating partner and vehicle solutions provider in Bristol.

Centrad.note: Centrad is an independent company founded and owned by its Managing Director Geoff Cross, and it continues to operate as a vehicle CCTV and telematics provider.

Contel Ltd.note: Contel Ltd was founded in 2017 by Thomas Finlay and Andrew Kelly and operates as an independent company providing connected fleet vehicle safety and video telematics solutions.

Data Driven Logistics Ltd.note: In 2021, Data Driven Holdings Limited acquired a majority controlling stake in Data Driven Logistics Limited, becoming a person with significant control.

Enerswitch UK Ltd.note: Enerswitch UK Ltd remains an independent company majority-owned by its founder and person with significant control, Jacob Bradley Hill, who holds 75% or more of the shares and voting rights.

FleetGS.note: FleetGS is an active cloud-based fleet management platform operated and owned by Rapid Dev Ltd.

Fleetview Solutions Ltd.note: Fleetview Solutions Ltd remains an active and independent vehicle tracking and telematics company in the UK.

GPSBob LTD.note: GPSBob LTD is active and operational under its own name, with the majority control held by Big Tom's Little Adventures Ltd (associated with founder Tom Smith).

Intelex Ltd.note: Intelex Ltd operates independently under its Fleetly brand, developing AI-driven video telematics solutions.

Kwiktrak UK Ltd.note: Kwiktrak UK Ltd operates as an independent provider of GPS tracking and fleet management systems.

Masternaut Limited.note: Masternaut Limited was acquired by Michelin in 2019 and operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary under the MICHELIN Connected Fleet brand identity.

Neural Stack Ltd.note: Neural Stack Ltd operates independently, developing and supporting its compliance and fleet management platform, Qinetic.

Pace Technology Ltd.note: Pace Technology Ltd remains independent, marketing its commercial vehicle fleet tracking capabilities under the Pace Track brand.

Qargo Limited.note: Qargo Limited operates independently following institutional venture-backed funding to scale its AI-driven transport management system.

Rooya UK Limited.note: Rooya UK Limited operates independently as a technology-focused corporate entity in the logistics segment.

SmarTrack Ltd.note: SmarTrack Ltd handles vehicle telematics and tracking independently, partnering with Global Telemetrics for monitored services.

TaxiCloud Ltd.note: TaxiCloud Ltd operates independently as an all-in-one software platform for taxi, private-hire, and chauffeur fleet operations.

ThingCo Limited.note: ThingCo Limited operates independently as a telematics and insurtech developer with minority backing from BHL (UK) Holdings.

Trackyou Limited.note: Acquired by Radius Payment Solutions in October 2016 and rebranded as UK Telematics in 2017.

UK Telematics.note: Acquired under its former name Trackyou Limited by Radius Payment Solutions in 2016.

VeriLocation Limited.note: Acquired by Isotrak in 2017 and later divested to Omegro in August 2025 to operate independently.

eCoachManager Ltd.note: Remains independent and actively acquired the membership organization Don't Travel Empty Ltd. in 2025.
